name: Royal Shades Curtains LLC
headline: Royal Shades Curtains LLC
lede: ROYAL SHADES CURTAINS are one of the leading manufacturer and suppliers of Blinds, Curtains, furniture, upholstery, canopy, awning, acoustic panels in Dubai...
about: Royal Shades Curtains LLC was founded in 2011 and has become one of the most trusted manufacturers of indoor shades, outdoor shades, upholstery & soft furnishing in UAE. We provide a full renovation system for a wide range of customers from retail, residential, offices, hotels, showrooms, and even hospitals.

We offer a comprehensive range of window treatments including sheer curtains, blackout curtains, motorized curtains, roller blinds, vertical blinds, zebra blinds, Roman blinds, Venetian blinds, Blackout blinds and combi blinds. All products are available in a wide selection of fabrics, colours, and finishes to match any interior.
